slides.texte_overlay:
Dress for the man
you're becoming.
Clean, fitted, simple.
You carry yourself
like what you wear.

Do one thing that scares you
every week.
Small fears, faced often,
become big courage.

Stop apologizing for
taking up space.
Not "sorry to bother you."
Just "quick question."

Get comfortable with silence.
You don't have to fill
every pause.
Calm men let it breathe.

Know things.
The more you learn,
the less you fear
any conversation.

history, science or art
in 5 minutes a day.
